verses.t: “Dasayime, bhikkhave, dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātuṁ. Katame dasa? Rāgaṁ, dosaṁ, mohaṁ, kodhaṁ, upanāhaṁ, makkhaṁ, paḷāsaṁ, issaṁ, macchariyaṁ, mānaṁ— ime kho, bhikkhave, dasa dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātuṁ.

Dasayime, bhikkhave, dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātuṁ. Katame dasa? Rāgaṁ, dosaṁ, mohaṁ, kodhaṁ, upanāhaṁ, makkhaṁ, paḷāsaṁ, issaṁ, macchariyaṁ, mānaṁ— ime kho, bhikkhave, dasa dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātun”ti. Dasamaṁ. Upālivaggo pañcamo.
Kāmabhogī bhayaṁ diṭṭhi, vajjiyamāhituttiyā; Kokanudo āhuneyyo, thero upāli abhabboti. Dutiyo paṇṇāsako samatto.
